car.instructions: Which car should answer this hall call? Prefer the car that will reach the calling floor soonest and can still take passengers.

criteria.A: floor 3.2, moving up, doors closed, 150 of 630 kg, 2 stops, 1 call
criteria.B: floor 12.0, idle, doors open, 0 of 630 kg, 0 stops, 0 calls
